configuration.laterGate: N >= 10, positive average R, >= 0.05R uplift versus active, barrier applied in both partitions
configuration.selection: highest development average-R uplift; minimum N 20, positive development average, and >= 0.05R development uplift
configuration.zoneMethod: confirmed H4 pivots; 120 completed bars; span 2; 0.25 ATR clustering; minimum 2 touches

limitations: This is reused historical research, not prospective validation or proof of executable fills.
H4 candles cannot order a stop and target touched inside the same candle; those cases remain ambiguous and are excluded from average R.
Confirmed pivot zones are deterministic approximations of support/resistance, not objective physical barriers or guaranteed reversal levels.
Spread, commission, slippage, swap, and gaps beyond recorded H4 prices are excluded.
